card.name: The word use after a drug class
card.fires_on: The word "use" right after a drug name or class (e.g. "antibacterial drug use", "antagonist use") in warning text. It also fires weakly on "with" after "treated" and on the end of "hypnotic".

modes.label: Drug use
modes.description: "use" completing a phrase like "[drug class] use" when linking an event to exposure.
modes.example: diarrhea following antibacterial drug<< use>>. Careful medical history is necessary since

modes.label: Treated with
modes.description: "with" after "treated" and before a product name.
modes.example: has occurred in patients treated<< with>> Unituxin. Institute appropriate medical treatment

modes.label: Hypnotic ending
modes.description: The final piece of "hypnotic" before "drug overdosage".
